what: Inside the background-color curtain, a 168px ring (radius 66, stroke 2.5) fills with progress (180ms ease) while the number counts 0→100. When full, the ring and number shrink out to .92x in .32s, and only the status text (small caps, .38em letter spacing) rises to the center and pulses .45↔.9 over 1.6s — while shaders compile. When done, the fill switches off in .12s power1.out, and .05s later the center hole opens from 84px to the screen’s diagonal radius over .85s power3.inOut (edge blurred across 80px with .55·.92 stops). When fully open, the curtain is hidden and fx:done fires.

options.status: Status text (e.g. COMPILING SHADERS). [data-fx-part=status] text may be written inside — to show it only after it is fully filled, leave it empty and supply it with fx:status
options.auto: Seconds to fill progress automatically, default 0 — at 0 it waits for fx:progress
options.hold: Time until the hole opens after it is full (sec), default .8 · wait waits for fx:finish (sent when shader baking finishes)
options.dur: Length of time the hole opens (sec), default .85
options.from: Initial hole radius (px), default 84 — same as the ring radius, so it opens at the ring position
options.fade: Duration (seconds) of the ring and text block fading out, default .12
options.fx:finish: Opens the hole right away (if not full, fills to 100 first)
options.fx:open · fx:done: When the hole starts to open · event the element fires after hiding the cover
options.--fx-ril-bg · --fx-ril-ink: Curtain background · ring and text color, default --kf-bg · --kf-ink

use: — The app registers it with el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fx:progress', { detail: .4 })) … when baking finishes 'fx:finish'
note: In the original, the ring fills while a 26MB asset downloads, so the moment it opens differs by connection. For frequently opened app screens, hold·dur are shortened (hold: 0; dur: .5)

from.where: index.html .tp-loader — original #app-loader (ring 168 · radius 66 · stroke 2.5, stroke-dashoffset 180ms ease, when full the stage goes opacity 0 · scale .92 320ms, status COMPILING SHADERS 1.6s pulse, finish: blob .12 power1.out · .04 revealing · from .05 --reveal 84px → diagonal .85 power3.inOut)
